name: Master Mingtong Gu
reason: Health rule: his own site (chicenter.com) sells Wisdom Healing Qigong mainly as physical and emotional healing, with in-person 'Healing Intensive' retreats and home-page claims that stress is the ultimate cause of illness and chronic disease and that qigong lets you heal, improve balance and prevent falls (his Shift courses include immunity-building qigong); his work is mainly condition- and healing-framed, so almost nothing passes the strict health rule. His newer 'Embodied Awakening' book and Pure Consciousness immersion could be reconsidered by a human.
